full_name: Suzanne Preston Blier | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2005–2006 Humanities Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Harvard University
bio: Suzanne Preston Blier, the Allen Whitehill Clowes Professor of Fine Arts and professor of African and African American studies at Harvard University, is an art and architectural historian specializing in the cultures and history of Africa.
